opening.argument: The presentation advances a two-leg, four-generation recruitment structure, stating that “OneCoin's plan is a binary with 4 generations of matching bonuses that increase from 10% to 25%.” It then makes extraordinary commissions appear attainable, claiming members have reached “close to $40,000 in earnings commissioned per week” while adding that “you might” achieve similar success. The pressure to recruit is explicit: viewers are told to “get positioned, and start building your team,” while warned that contacts may enroll elsewhere and cost them the claimed weekly benefit. The pitch further promotes appreciation of coins acquired while building the team, reinforcing the wealth appeal. Although it says results vary and does not guarantee income, the recruitment urgency, tiered compensation plan, and exceptional earnings claims present participation as a path to substantial commissions.
